description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the requested guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning types. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A black solid line, representing "tiny AdaLoRA_int4", begins at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 38 at epoch 6. A gray dashed line, representing "tiny AdaLoRA_int8", starts at approximately 63 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 39 at epoch 6. A light gray dotted line, representing "tiny int4", begins at approximately 58 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 37 at epoch 6. A dark gray dashed line, representing "tiny int8", starts at approximately 49 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 33 at epoch 6.
